user.title: Irabelle Waste Management
user.description: Create the hub. Bins are added afterwards with the **Add bin** button on the integration page.

data_description.collection_window_start: Motion while a bin is awaiting collection only counts as emptied inside this window.
data_description.collection_window_end: At this time a bin still awaiting collection is marked emptied, even if no motion was seen, when it was already out at the start of the window or when its calendar has a collection today.
data_description.away_minutes: A bin is awaiting collection once its normal advertisement has not been heard for this long.
data_description.return_confirm_seconds: A bin is back to filling once its normal advertisement has been heard continuously for this long.

error.window_order: The window must end after it starts (same day).

user.title: Add a bin
user.description: The Bluetooth proxies hear {count} iBeacon(s) that are not configured yet (strongest first). The beacon is read over Bluetooth next, so keep it near a proxy. {error}

data.name: Name
data.skip_beacon: Add without connecting to the beacon

data_description.address: The bin's beacon, or type its MAC address.
data_description.skip_beacon: Use the UUID the beacon advertises instead. You can configure the beacon later from the bin's Configure menu.

reconfigure.title: Configure bin ({address})
reconfigure.description: Beacon settings are read from the beacon each time you open a screen, so keep it within range of a Bluetooth proxy.

data_description.calendar_entity: Optional. Used for the next collection date and the bins-to-take-out summary.
data_description.calendar_keyword: Only events whose title contains this text (case-insensitive) count, e.g. `rubbish` or `recycling`. Empty matches every event.
data_description.battery_capacity: For the battery-life estimate: 1000 mAh for a CR2477, 220 mAh for a CR2032.
data_description.beacon_password: Only fill in to change the stored password (8-16 characters).

data.name: Beacon name
data.lBlk: Blink only when the battery is low

data_description.name: Up to 18 characters; this is the name the beacon advertises, not the bin name in Home Assistant.
data_description.meaPwr: Calibrated RSSI at 1 m, used for distance estimates.
data_description.atPwr: Turn on by itself when a battery is inserted.

beacon_slot_select.title: Beacon: advertising slots
beacon_slot_select.description: Pick a slot and what it should advertise. Choosing Disabled turns the slot off.

data.trAdv: Only advertise when a trigger fires

data_description.conn: Keep this on: without a connectable slot, Home Assistant (and the KBeacon app) can only connect after pressing the beacon's button.
data_description.trAdv: The slot stays silent until a trigger (e.g. motion) makes it advertise.
data_description.mode: Long range and extended advertising need Bluetooth 5 receivers; ESP32 proxies only hear Legacy.
data_description.uuid: Changing the UUID of the bin's idle advertisement updates the bin to follow it.

beacon_trigger_select.title: Beacon: triggers
beacon_trigger_select.description: Pick a trigger and its type. Choosing Disabled turns the trigger off.

data_description.trAChg: The bins detect motion through this: while triggered the beacon advertises a different UUID (last byte + 1).
data_description.trPara: Motion: sensitivity, 1 (most sensitive) to 126. Temperature: °C. Humidity: %. Light: lux. Angle: below this angle. Humidity periodically / PIR: interval in seconds. Periodically: period in ms.
data_description.ocnt: How many consecutive samples above the threshold count as motion.

beacon_export.title: Beacon: export settings
beacon_export.description: Copy this template and paste it in Import settings on another beacon. It contains everything except the beacon name, password, UUID, major and minor.

beacon_import.title: Beacon: import settings
beacon_import.description: Paste a template exported from another beacon. This beacon keeps its own name, password, UUID, major and minor; slots and triggers that are not in the template are turned off. {error}

data.allow_other_model: Allow a template from another model

beacon_password.title: Beacon: change password
beacon_password.description: The new password is written to the beacon and stored in the bin. Keep it safe: if it is lost, only a factory reset with the beacon's button recovers the beacon.

beacon_reset.title: Beacon: factory reset
beacon_reset.description: Restores the beacon's factory configuration: name, password (back to 0000000000000000), slots, UUIDs and triggers. The bin stops being tracked until you set it up again (motion trigger with UUID change, and the new idle UUID in Bin settings).

beacon_power_off.title: Beacon: power off
beacon_power_off.description: The beacon stops advertising until its button is pressed. The bin will show as away.

beacon_power.title: Beacon: power profiler
beacon_power.description:
Battery capacity {capacity} mAh, battery now {battery}%.

{breakdown}

**Average current: {current} mA**
**Estimated battery life: {months} months** (capacity × {efficiency}% efficiency ÷ average current ÷ 24 h ÷ 30 days)

As in KBeacon Pro, triggered advertising and time spent connected are not included.

data_description.battery_capacity: 1000 mAh for a CR2477, 220 mAh for a CR2032.
data_description.battery_efficiency: Share of the capacity actually usable; KKM recommends 75%.

beacon_setup.title: Set up {beacon_name}
beacon_setup.description: {model}, firmware {firmware}, battery {battery}%. Motion detection: **{motion}**. The UUID, major and minor below are read from the beacon; changing them writes them to the beacon. {error}

data_description.setup_motion: Makes the beacon advertise a different UUID (last byte + 1) for 30 s when moved, which is how emptying is detected. Recommended.
data_description.calendar_entity: Optional. Used for the next collection date and the bins-to-take-out summary.
data_description.calendar_keyword: Only events whose title contains this text (case-insensitive) count, e.g. `rubbish` or `recycling`. Empty matches every event.
data_description.battery_capacity: For the battery-life estimate: 1000 mAh for a CR2477, 220 mAh for a CR2032.

manual.title: Add without connecting
manual.description: The bin follows the UUID the beacon advertises now ({uuid}). Motion is any other UUID from the same beacon.

data_description.calendar_entity: Optional. Used for the next collection date and the bins-to-take-out summary.
data_description.calendar_keyword: Only events whose title contains this text (case-insensitive) count, e.g. `rubbish` or `recycling`. Empty matches every event.
data_description.battery_capacity: For the battery-life estimate: 1000 mAh for a CR2477, 220 mAh for a CR2032.
data_description.beacon_password: Only fill in to change the stored password (8-16 characters).

beacon_identity.title: Beacon: UUID, major & minor
beacon_identity.description: The bin follows iBeacon slot {slot}. Motion detection: **{motion}** (while moving the beacon advertises {motion_uuid}). Saving writes to the beacon and updates the bin.

data_description.setup_motion: Makes the beacon advertise a different UUID (last byte + 1) when moved, which is how emptying is detected.

beacon_sensor.title: Sensor: {sensor}
beacon_sensor.description: Read-only: {info}. Disable periods are daily time ranges (your local time) during which the sensor is turned off, e.g. no motion detection at night.

data_description.dPrd0_on: Careful with the accelerometer: while it is disabled, a bin being emptied is not detected (the 19:00 fallback still applies).

error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.same_uuid: The motion UUID must differ from the idle UUID.
error.all_channels_disabled: At least one channel must stay enabled.
error.import_rejected: This template cannot be applied (see above).
error.beacon_unreachable: Could not read the beacon (see above). Fix the password and try again, or add it without connecting.
error.beacon_write_failed: Could not write to the beacon (see above).
error.invalid_period: The start and end times must differ.

abort.identify_done: The beacon is flashing its LED.
abort.power_off_done: The beacon is powered off. Press its button to turn it on.
abort.not_heard: The proxies do not hear that beacon right now, so there is no UUID to follow. Move it near a proxy and try again.
abort.no_sensors: This beacon has no configurable sensors.

read_beacon_settings.name: Read beacon settings
read_beacon_settings.description: Connect to a bin's KBeacon and read all of its settings (common, slots, triggers, sensors). Returns them as the response.

device_id.name: Bin
device_id.description: The bin device whose beacon to use.

write_beacon_settings.description: Write raw KBeacon settings (same structure as the read response: common fields plus advObj/trObj/srObj lists), then read everything back.

device_id.description: The bin device whose beacon to use.

export_beacon_settings.description: Return a settings template of the beacon that can be imported into other beacons. It never includes the name, password, UUID, major or minor.

refresh.description: Read the current settings first instead of using the last ones read.
